summary.text: In a 2026 X post, Kennedy said the AI revolution is changing how people work and live and that the challenge is ensuring it does not change what makes us human. As HHS Secretary, he has described deploying AI to detect fraud in real time, making HHS a template for AI utilization, and said his agency is leading the federal government in driving AI into its activities. He has also advocated harnessing AI to improve health care delivery, including AI-powered diagnostics and telemedicine, and called for ending anti-competitive regulations to unleash AI innovation in health care.
